acceptance.given: FR-3 validator verification is requested for an available validator package.

oracle.expected: The validation result contains a validator-content-specific verification outcome independent of source, dependency, compatibility, support-policy, and trust outcomes.
forbidden: Validator content is treated as verified solely from verification of another aspect.
oracle.observable: The validator verification result artifact exposes a distinct validator-content check and its outcome.

acceptance.then: Validator content has an independently recorded verification result.
acceptance.when: Run the FR-3 validator verification and inspect the produced validation result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the validator-content result field and fail when it is absent or is satisfied only by another verification aspect.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit and verify a validator-content-specific result independently within the repository Toolchain validation flow.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; reverting restores the prior validation-result construction.

slice_hint.state_transition: Independent validator-content verification changes from unestablished to explicitly recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validation result has a distinct validator-content verification outcome.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result is evaluated as successful.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result includes an explicit, independently evaluated verification of non-authority bindings.
forbidden: Non-authority bindings are not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
oracle.observable: The successful Replay Result artifact contains a dedicated non-authority-bindings verification entry.

acceptance.then: Non-authority bindings are independently verified by that successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: Run replay evaluation and inspect a result considered successful.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a successful Replay Result and fail when it lacks an independent non-authority-bindings verification entry.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require a successful repository Toolchain Replay Result to report independent verification of non-authority bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior replay-result detail.

slice_hint.state_transition: A successful Replay Result changes from lacking an established independent non-authority check to carrying that check.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A Replay Result cannot be considered successful without its dedicated non-authority-bindings verification.

acceptance.given: An unexecuted-case input is supplied to the evaluation flow.

oracle.expected: The evaluation returns a rejection rather than success for the unexecuted case.
forbidden: Treating the unexecuted-case case as successful.
oracle.observable: The evaluated unexecuted-case result has a non-success rejection verdict.

acceptance.when: Execute the unexecuted-case evaluation selector and inspect its verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute an unexecuted-case evaluation and fail when the observed verdict is success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject unexecuted-case evaluation inputs in the repository Toolchain replay flow.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the former evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unexecuted case changes from a presented evaluation input to an explicit rejection verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The unexecuted-case evaluation returns rejection and never success.

acceptance.given: A candidate outcome is being evaluated for success with identity and execution facts supplied by the replay flow.

oracle.expected: The success predicate confirms required identity and execution facts are present and verifiable before allowing success.
forbidden: A success outcome is reported while required identity or execution facts are missing.
oracle.observable: The success-evaluation artifact records identity and execution fact presence or verification and produces a non-success result when any required fact is missing.

acceptance.then: Success remains blocked until all required identity and execution facts are present and verifiable.
acceptance.when: Evaluate the success predicate with complete and missing fact sets and inspect the produced verdict and fact checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a success evaluation with a missing or unverifiable identity or execution fact and fail if it reports success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Gate repository Toolchain success evaluation on complete, verifiable identity and execution facts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior success predicate.

slice_hint.state_transition: Success evaluation changes from permitting incomplete facts to blocking success until every required fact is present and verifiable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No success verdict is emitted if any required identity or execution fact is unknown, missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.
